node.statement: For every n and Y in M_n tensor S^{A_R}_{P^R,Q^R}, the exact range identity Y=F^R_{P,Q}(Y), followed by the same fixed internal-product telescope in reverse and the ambient compression-to-raw-product estimate, gives ||Co^A_{P,Q}(Y)-Y|| <= C_rev*t*||Y|| with a universal coefficient independent of n. Taking C_nest=max(C_proj,C_fwd,C_rev) and e_nest no larger than all thresholds proves node 1.
